causal_intervention: Single-pose surgery only. No new backbone, no ray-aware transformer, no DPM/GGPT route, no D3 matcher, no resolution increase.

checkpoint_selection.panel: 16 tune families, e00 A-only sample, every epoch

correspondence_contract: Cross-view persistence/correspondence is required semantically; an explicit learned Z is optional.

data.forbidden_truth_on_gpu: all Pose-B, scene-flow, differential/mechanics, authored rig and training-only carrier identity fields

decision_policy.G1_product_pass: NOT_DEFINED; G1 is a baseline/causal gate, not final product qualification
decision_policy.geometry_good_but_safety_or_grounding_we: route to G4 explicit geometric grounding/refinement
decision_policy.geometry_good_with_remaining_localizatio: route to G5 and consider D2/D3 reserve components
decision_policy.weak_common_frame_geometry: route to G3 direct common-frame pointmap/surface formulation

causal_diagnostics: fixed nontrivial view-image permutation while camera/view-token positions remain fixed
deterministic wrong-family single-view injection on dev
evaluation.causal_diagnostics_are: diagnostic localization evidence, not product thresholds
evaluation.dev_open: exactly once after BEST checkpoint is frozen
evaluation.panel_aggregation: family mean + median + p90 + p95 for every finite metric

objective.P: smooth-L1 point error weighted by learned log_sigma; no teacher latent/mechanical term
objective.V: binary cross entropy on per-view observability

passive_preservation.D1_D2_D3: preserved RESERVE_CALLABLE; not active in G1
passive_preservation.camera_residual: diagnostic only; parameters frozen; zero G1 loss authority
passive_preservation.descriptor_z: exposed for diagnostics/provenance only; head parameters frozen; zero G1 loss authority

question: With Pose B and all mechanical/cross-pose objectives removed, can the retained IRIS multiview core produce a usable common-frame surface from A×8 alone?

training.family_order: deterministic reshuffle each epoch from seed_base + epoch

warmstart.policy: Load every shape-compatible retained N1D tensor; fail closed on any missing destination or shape mismatch.
